sources.title: Block-diagonalization of infinite-volume lattice Hamiltonians with unbounded interactions
sources.locators: Lemma 4.1 and equations 4.232-4.252, PDF pages 36-38 (one-based; indices 35-37); Appendix Lemma A.3, A.8-A.10, PDF page 50 (index 49).
sources.reading_depth: Independently read lemma hypotheses, inverse construction, weighted-inverse proof through 4.252, and A.3 assumptions/statements. Adjacent beginning of recurrence proof read; full induction not reconstructed. PDF metadata verified; screenshot request unavailable.
sources.matched_hypotheses: A gapped interacting local operator and an energy comparison precede its homological inverse; initial workbench counterparts are proved directly.
sources.gap: The lemma assumes evolving potential bounds and a prior gap at each stage. Neither its unevaluated small-coupling threshold nor later-stage hypotheses follow from the initial O1 diagonal.
sources.conventions: Derive [S,G]=-A directly from the frozen workbench definition; do not import an isolated displayed sign.

scope: Primary reading supports method comparison. The actual SU2 character, boundary and numerical estimates are independent derivations from the contract and admitted I1/O1 model, not imported theorem constants.
